item.title: Alibaba Cloud Ships Qwen3.8-Max on DigitalOcean Serverless Inference as Day 0 Partner
item.summary: Alibaba Cloud launched Qwen3.8-Max — a 2.4-trillion-parameter, 1-million-token-context model — on DigitalOcean Serverless Inference, with DigitalOcean serving as the Day 0 launch partner and offering usage-based API access on NVIDIA HGX B300 GPUs.
